description: The board: the ticket store on the engine, the two tools the agent opens and moves one with, and the Pipeline page the client reads it on
client_copy: El tablero donde ves en qué está trabajando tu agente y cómo va cada pedido.
_comment: THE ROOT OF THE SYSTEM GRAPH, AND THE ONE PLUGIN WITH NO SKILLS SURFACE.
There is no SKILL.md to ship because there is nothing to teach: the store
is code, the tools carry their own descriptions, and the screen is the
portal's own page against /portal/tickets.
THE STORE IS THIS PLUGIN'S NOW. Until 15/9/2026 this manifest existed only
for the dependency: the board was the ENGINE's (the `kanban` toolset,
`hermes kanban ...`, the sqlite the adapter read with PRAGMA query_only)
and `core` answered /portal/tickets with an empty list. On the engine the
board is a plugin like any other -- `core/board_store.py` creates its two
tables in the engine's SQLite when it loads, `core/board_routes.py` serves
the five calls the portal already types, and `core/board_tools.py` puts
`create_ticket` and `update_ticket` on the face, ungated: a ticket is
internal, and the gate is for what the agent does outwards.
AND THAT IS WHY `requires.toolsets: [kanban]` IS GONE. That named the
toolset Hermes turns on to give the agent its own board CLI, and there is
no Hermes here (docs/engine-verdict.md, CLAUDE.md's engine decision). A
plugin declaring it would be asking this engine for a word it does not
know.
SO WHAT THE DEPENDENCY IS STILL FOR: approval, deliverable, artifact and
flow all write into a TICKET, so the graph says it out loud and the build
refuses a capability that carries one of them without this.
